title: Elsa C Probable NDE
content:
I felt ill while driving. I called medics and was admitted to the hospital. Later that evening, I sat down and was unable to get up. Then I began to act irrationally. Next, I became aware of a wall passing by with pictures on it. I realized that I was on a gurney; however, I also realized I was not in my body. I was hovering over it. I felt a lightness I'd never felt before. I also felt relief from all life's problems and responsibilities. I was happy that I had finished all my will documents. Everything had worked out well. I had never felt so at peace. I thought I might have had a stroke or that I might die soon, but it did not trouble me.

Next, I saw myself being slid off the gurney and onto a cat scan table. The people sliding me paid no attention to me. They did not know I could see them. I think they talked with one another briefly.

Then, I was sitting up on my hospital bed. A nurse was to my right, and using her arms a lot. She spoke to me, although her language made no sense. There were a number of people at the foot of my bed staring at me. They were shrouded in black, although one figure in front had a visible face. She had black hair and round, black glasses. All the people looked so concerned and well-meaning. The nurse continued to gesture to me and seemed to want me to answer questions. I tried to speak to her, but my language was nonsensical like hers. It was very amusing. I quickly gave up trying to speak to her.

Later, I was still on the bed. I saw myself slip into my body from the back and heard a loud swish sound. A nurse was there, and I told her I felt fine.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness Life threatening event, but not clinical death Very low blood pressure
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I just saw the surrounding near me. I clearly left my body and existed outside it
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal. I felt very clear-headed I think considering what was happening.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. There didn't seem to be any time.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: I don't remember a lot prior to the experience. I had felt very ill when calling 911.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Elation. I felt free of all earthly concerns. Relaxed. Happy. Relieved.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: No. I recalled being outside my attorney's office and feeling relief that I had finished the paperwork.
elements.What was your religion prior to your exp: Christian- Catholic I don't practice much
elements.Have your religious practices changed si: Yes I know I can comfort myself if I pray now.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes. I believed you had to suffer in order to die.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Uncertain. At first, I was pretty sure I had not died; but at the same time I was aware that I was no longer in my body. Being out of body felt fairly permanent.
Yes Difficultly putting my affairs in order for my loved ones.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes I had my brother give details of his two near-death experiences. I knew he wasn't lying. I also heard of my brother-in-law's experience of seeing my father in their house the evening of his death.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real. I knew I had experienced it. I had not dreamed it. I had no doubt about it.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I have felt very tearful often afterwards. I finally realized that I am sad that I could not go and not come back. It still makes me angry.
